component.name: Wealthfolio
component.summary: Local-first tracker for investments, net worth and spending

description.p: This is a community package of Wealthfolio, maintained independently. It repackages the official upstream build unmodified.
Wealthfolio is a private portfolio tracker that keeps your financial data on your own device, in a local database, with no account to create.

ul.li: Track holdings, cash and net worth across several accounts and currencies.
Follow performance, income and dividends over time.
Record spending and see where the money goes.
Run savings and contribution scenarios against your own numbers.
Import activity from CSV statements and export what you need back out.
Extend the app with add-ons from its catalogue.

description.p: Your portfolio database and settings stay in the application's private per-app directory, which Flatpak redirects into ~/.var/app/com.teymz.wealthfolio. By default this package can additionally read and write files in your Documents and Downloads directories, which is what CSV import and report export use.

To use another directory for statements, grant only that location: flatpak override --user --filesystem=/path/to/statements com.teymz.wealthfolio. To expose your whole home directory instead, opt in with flatpak override --user --filesystem=home com.teymz.wealthfolio. Remove custom grants with flatpak override --user --reset com.teymz.wealthfolio.

The package talks to the Secret Service so the application can store the credentials of its optional sync in your keyring. Market data lookups and the add-on catalogue need network access. Install application updates through Flatpak; the built-in updater cannot replace the read-only Flatpak application.
